basic_info.description: Located at the crossroads of Pacific Heights and Presidio Heights, this two-story, top-floor condo lives like a single-family home with sweeping, unobstructed views and soaring 10-ft ceilings on the main level. A gracious facade on a quiet, tree-lined block (currently designated as a Slow Street) sets the tone for this elegant, light-filled residence. The spacious and house-like layout features three oversized bedrooms and two full baths plus a large office/flex space, all thoughtfully arranged on one levelincluding a serene primary suite with double closets and an en-suite bath. The thoughtfully-designed kitchen (a previous owner was a chef!), complete with premium appliances and stone countertops, flows seamlessly into the living and dining rooms, each with their own private decks and expansive outlooks perfect for entertaining. The city views are stunning any time of day or night! Enjoy a private garage (with room to park a second car in front of the space) and a large, easily accessible storage area dedicated to the unit. Situated in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, you're just steps from Sacramento Street, the JCC, Laurel Village, and top-rated schools
